serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m back. 
'Nun' Shanice: Great to hear that.
'Nun' Shanice: I’m almost done here, It was easier than I thought. 
You: That’s great! Is my bot alright though?
'Nun' Shanice: Yeah, she is. I didn’t really mess with her settings or other stuff. 
'Nun' Shanice: I just hope this all will be able to help Priestbot.
'Nun' Shanice: I will go home now. Give me some time and come back to church at the usual hour.
You: Sure, good luck with repairs.
'Nun' Shanice: Bye Bye~
